source.method: straight-line fit to the published characteristic curve over one log H window shared by all three channels, [1.56, 3.46], on the sheet's own relative log exposure axis, anchored at the printed EI 250 (the cine exposure index) through the ISO 5800 speed point (green and the slower of red and blue, each at minimum density plus 0.15, reached at relative log H 1.51), a shift of -3.76, which makes the window Kodak's [-2.2, -0.3]

name: Kodak Vision3 250D
note: Dye gammas are this stock's own, read off its maker's published characteristic curve. Nothing here is measured from a roll.
